description: Use this whenever the user wants to share, send, show, or publish something you produced: a report, a dashboard, a prototype, a Markdown doc, a PDF, an image. Publishes it to a durable URL that stays live, and returns the link. Pushing the same name again creates a new version at the same link rather than a second link, so prefer reusing a name over inventing one. Pass either `path` (html, md, pdf, png, jpg, gif, webp) or inline `content` with a `filename` (html or md). If the page collects answers or signs people in, read https://usething.ai/html-api.txt first, and act on any `notes` in the result.

content.description: Inline document text (HTML or Markdown) — use with filename

filename.description: Filename for inline content, e.g. report.html or notes.md

home.description: Make this artifact the project's page (needs project; project owners and editors only). Inside it, thing.project.get() lists the project's artifacts for each reader

password.description: Set a password; anyone who knows it can open the artifact beside workspace and people access

path.description: Path to the file to push

project.description: Project slug in that workspace. Restricted projects are seen only by their members and workspace admins; guests from outside the workspace can push only into projects where they are editors

team.description: Workspace address to push to (a workspace is called a team in the API; defaults to the user's default workspace)

visibility.description: Who can see it: private is only you and people you add, team is everyone in the workspace (or, in a project, the project's people), public is anyone with the link

name: push_artifact
